about.title: About LORO
about.lead: LORO is field sales software built for South African B2B teams—visits, routes, pipeline, maps, and ERP-ready ordering in one platform.
about.replaceSpreadsheets: We help manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors replace spreadsheet chaos with visit proof, manager dashboards, and mobile workflows reps actually use on the road.
about.connectsSuffix: , LORO connects field activity to revenue—not admin for its own sake.
about.workforce: Optional workforce modules (attendance, leave) sit alongside field sales for teams that want one login for ops and people.

pricing.lead: Flexible field sales software for teams in South Africa—scale users and branches as you grow.

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.body: Multi-branch rollout, ERP integration, IoT, and advanced reporting.

customers.title: Customers
customers.lead: South African businesses use LORO to run field sales with less admin and clearer accountability.

distributors.title: Field-first distributors

dashboard.title: Managers with one dashboard
dashboard.body: Leaders see visits, leads, and period progress without chasing reps on WhatsApp for updates.

erp.title: ERP-aligned ordering

customers.footnote: Case studies with named logos are added as customers approve publication. Request a reference walkthrough via sign-up.

blog.subtitle: Guides for South African field sales managers and reps.

platform.erp: In-house ERP built in and integrated—products, customers, orders, and B2B store flows in one stack. Optional Sage, Acumatica, and SAP bridges for mixed finance stacks.
platform.saas: Cloud-based SaaS with Clerk authentication and organisation-scoped access for reps and managers.

repsly.title: LORO vs Repsly
repsly.lead: Factual comparison for teams evaluating retail execution and field sales platforms.
repsly.loroFocus: SA B2B field sales, visits, pipeline, ERP orders
repsly.repslyFocus: CPG retail execution, shelf & promo programmes
repsly.loroDiff: Competitor map intel + optional workforce modules
repsly.repslyErp: Retail execution focus; ERP via integrations
repsly.footnote: Choose Repsly when shelf analytics and CPG programmes dominate. Choose LORO when B2B visits, pipeline, and SA ERP-aligned field sales are the priority.

skynamo.title: LORO vs Skynamo
skynamo.lead: Both serve South African field sales—compare fit for your ERP, team size, and modules.
skynamo.loroPosition: Field sales + pipeline + competitor maps + optional HR
skynamo.skynamoPosition: Unified sales channels, mobile ordering, RADAR AI
skynamo.loroBest: Visit proof, competitor maps, optional workforce
skynamo.footnote: Run a parallel pilot on visits and pipeline before migrating ERP interfaces.

zoho.title: LORO vs Zoho CRM
zoho.lead: Zoho CRM is a broad AI CRM suite; LORO is purpose-built for outside sales execution in South Africa.
zoho.footnote: Choose Zoho when you need a general CRM across the whole business. Choose LORO when field visits, routes, and SA B2B execution are the bottleneck.

integrations.title: ERP integrations
integrations.lead: Connect LORO field sales to the systems that hold customers, products, and orders—so reps sell with live data on the road.
integrations.sageBlurb: Popular in South African SMB and mid-market finance stacks.
integrations.acumaticaBlurb: Cloud ERP context for field quotes and orders.
integrations.sapBlurb: Enterprise product and account data for large field teams.

sage.title: Sage + LORO field sales
sage.lead: Align Sage ERP or accounting data with visits, pipeline, and B2B orders your reps capture in the field.
sage.finance: South African teams often run Sage for finance while reps still quote from outdated lists. LORO brings customer and product context into visit and order workflows so field and finance share one story.
sage.hubPrefix: Roll out visits and pipeline first, then connect ordering flows with your integration partner. See the full

sap.title: SAP + LORO field operations
sap.lead: Enterprise field programmes with SAP-backed master data and LORO visit, pipeline, and map execution.
sap.governed: Large field teams need governed product and account data with fast mobile UX. LORO layers visit tracking, route planning, and manager dashboards on top of your SAP rollout patterns.
sap.engage: Engage your integration team early for customer, material, and order interfaces scoped to your landscape.

acumatica.title: Acumatica + LORO
acumatica.lead: Cloud ERP inventory and customers available where reps plan routes and close orders.
acumatica.proof: Acumatica teams gain field visit proof and pipeline visibility without forcing reps into desktop ERP screens at every stop.
acumatica.execution: LORO focuses on execution—visits, maps, competitor context, and mobile ordering—while your ERP remains the system of record.

competitor.title: Competitor intelligence on a map
competitor.lead: Track rival accounts beside your clients—threat levels, locations, and context for sharper field debriefs.
competitor.landscape: Reps and managers see competitive landscape geographically, not in scattered spreadsheets.
competitor.afterSignIn: After sign-in, use the map visualiser for live field layers, visit filters, and influence views alongside client accounts.

visits.title: Visit tracking software
visits.lead: Prove field work with check-ins, notes, quotes, and outcomes tied to each customer account.
visits.managers: Managers see which accounts were visited, what was discussed, and what happened next—without disputed activity logs.
visits.feeds: Visits feed pipeline and reports so coaching uses the same data reps entered on site.

workforce.title: Workforce & attendance
workforce.lead: Optional HR modules alongside field sales—attendance, leave, and payroll signals under the same LORO login.
workforce.suffix: ; workforce tools suit teams that want ops and people data together.
workforce.localSupport: South African teams benefit from local support across both field and HR workflows where enabled.

routes.title: Route planning for field sales
routes.lead: Tasks, daily routes, reminders, and maps—built from visits, leads, and pipeline priorities.
routes.driving: Reps spend less time driving between low-value stops and more time with accounts that move revenue.
routes.suffix: so planned vs completed routes are visible to leaders.

fieldSales.title: Field sales software
fieldSales.lead: One platform for South African B2B field teams: mobile reps, office managers, and ERP-aligned orders.
fieldSales.repsBody: Plan the day, log visits with evidence, update leads, and place orders from a fat-finger-friendly mobile experience with resilient sync.
fieldSales.managersBody: Pipeline targets, visit coverage, and map visualisation—know who hit which accounts without end-of-week email chases.

pipeline.title: Sales pipeline for field teams
pipeline.lead: Leads, period targets, converted wins, and visit outcomes on one screen.
pipeline.slides: Field managers stop rebuilding Friday slides—quota progress and next actions live in LORO alongside CRM-style lead stages.
pipeline.suffix: modules for a complete outside-sales stack.
